description: This file defines the UserDao interface, which extends a generic DAO interface for managing User entities in the system. It declares methods for retrieving users by username, listing all users, and listing users by merchant store.

classes.name: UserDao
classes.description: An interface for data access operations related to User entities, extending generic DAO capabilities.

methods.name: getByUserName
methods.description: Retrieves a User entity matching the provided username.

methods.name: listUser
methods.description: Returns a list of all User entities.

methods.name: listUserByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of User entities associated with a given MerchantStore.
